decision: Complete the kill rule as Clarity decision architecture before the DAF cost center opens: for the named-partner and referenceable-pilot tests record the monitoring signal, threshold, underlying trigger claim, owner, operational response, reassessment response and trigger reassessment condition; decide whether OD-P3-03/04 also start the month-24 pilot clock; fix the cost-center definition (P3-DEC-MOD001) and the allocation rule (P3-DEC-MOD002) before the first DAF-specific spend and change them afterwards only to reduce ambiguity
options: (a) keep the rule as signal and threshold only; (b) complete the trigger record as proposed; (c) complete it and also start both clocks at the cost-center month
reversibility: High before the clock starts; low after (a redefinition after spend weakens the control)
evidence_needed: Owner ruling on the month-24 clock; V-6 contact log to calibrate P3-HYP-CE001

decision: Make revenue per customer at a named customer size an explicit gate before any sequence commitment: V-2 and V-6 must establish whether paying customers are (i) large sponsors at ER-7 scale, (ii) a partner's aggregated book or (iii) hosted programmes; treat P3-DEC-CD001 (host-sponsor programme route) as an adoption and reference route, not the primary revenue route, until the gate is met
options: (a) adopt A3 on ER-7 revenue as modelled; (b) adopt P3-DEC-CD001 as primary route; (c) gate the choice on revenue per customer at a named size
reversibility: High (planning rule; no build or contract)
evidence_needed: P3-VAL-CE001; V-2 nonbinding EOIs with account counts; V-6 term-sheet economics
